change: CONTACT_OPENING contact-model evidence broadened from deck-only to layered deck -> .msg banner -> .dat keyword echo, with fail-closed suppression when no layer applies; .dat and .msg extraction windows fixed to head+tail so the evidence is reachable through the orchestrator.

extraction_windows.problem: Both extractors kept only the last 100 lines. The .dat keyword echo and model summary are at the head, and the real M_U_T001 .msg banner is at line 74 of 11673, so both solver-artifact evidence layers were unreachable through the product path.
extraction_windows.fix: msg and dat now read the first 100 and last 100 lines; sta and log are unchanged. Reads stay bounded.

evidence_layers.msg: Header line 'CONTACT CONTROLS APPLIED TO ALL CONTACT PAIRS:' or 'CONTACT CONTROLS APPLIED TO CONTACT PAIR (...)'.
evidence_layers.dat: Echoed *contactpair keyword, or 'NUMBER OF INTERNAL ELEMENTS GENERATED FOR CONTACT' greater than zero.

deliberately_excluded.*contactcontrols: The remediation writes this exact card, so accepting it as evidence would be circular.
deliberately_excluded.bare 'contact' keyword in .msg: Abaqus/Standard 2025 prints generic contact tolerances for every model, including no-contact models.
deliberately_excluded.node-level surface attribution: Singular-node names cannot be reliably mapped to a contact surface from the captured artifacts.

reasons: The closed loop and the broadened gate are demonstrated on one gap-closure geometry plus controls, not on a customer assembly.
